title: Maintenance inspections.
officialText:
Expansion joints, anchorage and guides shall be inspected as follows:
1. Expansion joints shall be visually inspected monthly.
2. The anchorage and guides shall be visually inspected annually. Exposure of the structural attachments to the buildings of the
anchorages or guides shall not be required.
3. A record of such inspections shall be kept by the person in charge of the mechanical equipment of the building or other
qualified person designated by the owner and acceptable to the commissioner. The records shall be available at the premises
and subject to inspection by the commissioner.
